## Modules

- [OneDHCPD](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.md): The One Address DHCP Server!
- [OneDHCPD.ARP](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.ARP.md): This module contains utilities to view or update the ARP cache.
- [OneDHCPD.ARP.Entry](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.ARP.Entry.md): One entry in the ARP table

- [OneDHCPD.IPCalculator](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.IPCalculator.md): This module handles IP address calculations.
- [OneDHCPD.Message](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.Message.md): DHCP Message
- [OneDHCPD.Server](https://one-dhcpd.hexdocs.pm/OneDHCPD.Server.md): This is the OneDHCPD Server.
